trigger: Verifier private copies made with 'cp -cR … (exclude nothing)' carried 89 copies of the user's gitignored scripts/signing_credentials.sh, and work copies ~200 of Local.xcconfig (P8 whole-run verification).
lesson: A full-tree copy of a user's repository picks up gitignored secrets and machine-local config; instructions that say 'exclude nothing' propagate that to every helper.
how_to_apply: Make every private copy with an explicit exclude list for known secret/local files (rsync --exclude=scripts/signing_credentials.sh --exclude=Local.xcconfig …) and state it in the executor AND verifier guides; sweep the run dir for those names before cleanup.
